FN-M3P8WH1-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 81
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/12/2024
Senate Bill 81 as introduced would increase the state-paid salary of all registrars in the state,
from $80 per day currently, to $100 per day which would increase the obligations of the State
General Fund by an estimated maximum $802,300 annually.
Page 1

FN-M3P8WH1-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 81
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/05/2024
Senate Bill 81 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the State General Fund by
an estimated maximum of $800,000 annually, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025, by increasing the
state-paid salary of all registrars in the state from $80 per day, currently, to $100 per day.
